parole.significato: used for emphasis in enumeration of entries
parole.testo: Combines: * An emphatic particle derived from Proto-Slavic *ba, *bo, coordinate to де (de), же (že), ле (le). * A form of address borrowed from Ottoman Turkish به, from Byzantine Greek βρέ (bré), probably a colloquial form of Ancient Greek μωρέ (mōré), the vocative of μωρός (mōrós, “dull”).
